name: hud_ui_text_stack_push_line
description: HudUiTextStack4::PushLine enables the stack, suppresses duplicate top-line shifts, shifts older visible rows down, and writes the new top message and timer.
known_limits: Tier S verification was attempted with VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs and remains blocked by 226 unmasked byte mismatches. The drift is source-shape/codegen: prologue register lifetime, inlined strcmp register allocation, and row-shift loop shape. Binary Ninja still renders the inlined text comparison and row-stride copy through low-level artifacts, but assembly and smoke coverage agree on the functional contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bd160 validates stack enablement, top-line duplicate suppression, downward row shifting with timer/text/color copy, and writing the new line 0 text/timer visible.
The native text-stack smoke verifies initial push, duplicate top-line refresh without shifting, and changed-message shifting behavior.
